question: What must be done with all those elements and the individual soul, O goddess Pārvatī?
premises: All those elements are taken as objects.
The individual soul is also involved.
They are to be deposited or placed in the prescribed manner.
inference: The practice requires depositing all those elements together with the individual soul.
uncertainties: The locus into which they are deposited is supplied by the following verses.
plain_english: O goddess Pārvatī, having deposited all those and the individual soul.
